title: botryopleuron axillare
intro: Botryopleuron axillare, commonly known as Indian valerian, is a plant species that belongs to the family Valerianaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, thanks to its numerous health benefits. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Botryopleuron axillare include valerenic acid, valerenol, and isovaleric acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
